newsitem.title: USA: GOLF-PRESIDENTS CUP SCORES ON FRIDAY.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-PRESIDENTS CUP SCORES ON FRIDAY.

text.p: first day at the Presidents Cup played at the 7,289-yard,
par-72 Robert Trent Jones Golf Club on Thursday:
Fred Couples and Davis Love (U.S.) beat Greg Norman and
Corey Pavin and Phil Mickelson (U.S.) beat Vijay Singh and
David Duval and Mark O'Meara (U.S.) beat Steve Elkington and
Tom Lehman and Steve Stricker (U.S.) beat Nick Price and
Ernie Els and Mark McNulty (International) beat Scott Hoch
Kenny Perry and Justin Leonard (U.S.) beat Nick Price and
Mark O'Meara and David Duval (U.S.) beat Craig Parry and
Fred Couples and Davis Love (U.S.) beat Greg Norman and
Steve Elkington and Vijay Singh (Australia) beat Tom Lehman
Corey Pavin and Phil Mickelson (U.S.) halved with Ernie Els
